change: Explicitly supersedes the original-thread repair plus recovery-copy design. The source stays intact; clone an official empty target, then only repair the target. Runtime owns the final target-provider load, settings restoration and operation acknowledgement.

interface.copy-inspect: {expected,sourceMetadata}; metadata contains original baseInstructions/dynamicTools/selectedCapabilityRoots and last same-thread summary/serviceTier. No plannedRepairSha256 or speculative original repair.
interface.recovery-copy: {copied:true,sourcePreserved:true,expected:unchangedSourceWitness,target:{threadId,expected:newTargetWitness}}. No source gzip backup or source backup capacity consumption.
interface.repair: Existing exact-witness, official-writer-lock, private target gzip backup, atomic replacement and unknown-after-publication semantics remain unchanged. Runtime must direct it only to the newly created target.

preservedChecks: Fixed native identity and HOME; regular owned no-symlink/no-hardlink entries; distinct source/target IDs and files.
Independent plain paginated source and single-header ordinal-zero native target only.
Current provider/cwd metadata corroboration with header fallback, base instruction text and dynamic/capability metadata consistency.
Both source and target native writer locks under shared coordination.
Source and target SHA/stat witnesses before work and before final target publication.
Native target header and every source nonheader byte preserved at copy. Source witness remains exactly unchanged.
Nonempty target/replayed old request rejected; failures after publication remain unknown and preserve named partial target.
removed: Unused planned repair hash calculation for the discarded original-thread recovery store.
Redundant source raw gzip backup in copy action. The original remains the user-visible original thread.

linux.rootCase: Both real fixed-UID launchers copy to a distinct target, reject cross-home/replay, then repair only target; source bytes/witness remain unchanged and gzip belongs to target ID.

limits: Not an independent review of this reviewer-authored Python helper; parent reviews it separately.
Real CLI probe validates helper and history/projection behavior, not final RuntimeService permission/effort/collaboration/summary/tier restoration; runtime author owns that end-to-end test.
Source unchanged means byte/stat witness after native writer close. Native final writer flush happens before that witness is captured.
Legacy/inherited/compressed inputs remain explicitly unsupported for this copy path, not silently reconstructed.

Benchmark is synthetic repetitive data, excludes native projection/UI and worst-case incompressible backup. At 128MiB observed inspect0.217s/copy0.659s/target repair1.012s, cumulative process peak58.1MB.
No full suite, online deployment, live instance writes, paid inference or external MCP calls.
